Photo: Merab Dvalishvili / Instagram Show caption: A screenshot taken from Merab Dvalishvili's Instagram Storie… Merab Dvalishvili left bloodied after attack by Usman Nurmagomedov during hotel interview in Abu Dhabi
 Footage shows Russian approaching Georgian from behind before striking him ahead of RAF Abu Dhabi
 Steve Luckings November 11, 2026
 Add on Google Merab Dvalishvili was attacked by a group led by Usman Nurmagomedov while giving an interview in a hotel lobby ahead of this weekend's RAF Abu Dhabi. 
 A video posted by UFC fighter Ilia Topuria, since deleted, showed Dvalishvili talking to the camera when he is approached from behind by a group led by Nurmagomedov. The footage showed Dvalishvili turning to face the Russian, who struck him before a melee ensued. 
 Dvalishvili then posted an expletive-filled video on his social media channels after the incident while medics attended to his wounds. The Georgian had at least one cut to his head that left his face bloodied.

 Read More Arrow “Was doing an interview for RAF in hotel lobby and Usman and his buddies came up from behind and started punching me and my young friend,” Dvalishvili wrote in a caption. “Security was holding me - they kept kicking us when we were down like losers.” 
 Merab Dvalishvili, left, said he and his friend were attacked by a group led by MMA fighter Usman Nurmagomedov. Photo: Merab Dvalishvili / Instagram Show caption: Merab Dvalishvili, left, said he and his friend were attacke… Dvalishvili is set to face Marlon Moraes on Saturday night as part of the RAF's first card in the Middle East. 
 It remains to be seen whether his injuries will prevent Dvalishvili from wrestling at Etihad Arena. The RAF has been contacted by The National for comment on the incident. 
 Dvalishvili , 35, has history with the Nurmagomedovs. In 2005, he beat Usman's older brother, Umar, at UFC 311 via unanimous decision to defend the UFC bantamweight title. 
 The rivalry has flared up again in recent months. Dvalishvili was involved in a scuffle with an associate of Umar’s ahead of UFC Georgia, leading to the two trading insults in the media. 
 Umar is also set to wrestle on Saturday's RAF Abu Dhabi card against Urijah Faber. 
 Usman, 28, is not on the card but frequently attends his brother's MMA and wrestling bouts. 
 Formerly a lightweight champion with the PFL, the Russian is now a free agent and is widely expected to sign with the UFC. 
 Dvalishvili returns to Abu Dhabi just weeks after fighting Petr Yan in the co-main event at UFC 333. 
 The Georgian lost by unanimous decision as Yan retained the bantamweight title.
